target_customer: Marketing and sales teams at companies that want branded guest-interview and testimonial videos without a physical studio
problem: Producing marketing and sales video required on-site studios or low-quality DIY recording. ClearMix claimed remote production that is 4x faster and 10x cheaper.
business_model: Per-video production service sold online, with producers and editors on a remote platform

founders.name: Gabe Ruttner
education: Cornell, Master's in computer science and AI (per YC page)
founders.background_notes: YC page also lists him as co-founder and CTO of Hatchet (W24), a later company.

founders.name: Tomer Dorfan
founders.background_notes: YC page describes him as an attorney turned founder.

founders.name: Ian Folau
founders.background_notes: Named as CEO in the 2022 seed press release and the Product Hunt newsletter item; not listed on the YC page I read.

competitors.name: Riverside.fm
competitors.what: Remote video and audio recording platform for podcasts and interviews
competitors.funding_then: Reported $2.5M seed led by Oren Zeev, announced at its launch from stealth

competitors.name: Zencastr
competitors.what: Remote podcast recording tool named as the rival in Riverside's launch coverage

technical_complexity.rationale: A marketplace and recording workflow built from web video and a producer queue; the hard parts were operations and producer quality, not research.

defensibility.rationale: Remote recording and editing services were easy to replicate, and the founders' own release named only DIY tools and on-site studios as alternatives. Producer network was the only soft asset.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source shows an incumbent copying or buying ClearMix. CB Insights lists a stage of acquired with no buyer or date, which no second source supports.

market_need_then: Remote work in 2020 cut access to physical studios, and the company said it drew interest from several top 50 Fortune 500 companies (2022 release). No independent spend data found.

branding.domain_note: Uses exact clearmix.com. History not found.

identity.logo: A Dribbble case study by an agency says the mark combines a letter C, an audio wave and a video timeline
identity.visual_style: Per the same case study, uses a gradient for dynamism

brand_strength.rationale: Only an agency logo showcase and Product Hunt launch coverage were found; no press about the brand itself or community.

outcome_analysis: ClearMix went through YC in Summer 2020 and raised a 3.25 million dollar seed in February 2022 from Scout Ventures, Bloomberg Beta, Runa Capital and Liquid2. The YC directory marks it inactive, but no shutdown notice, post-mortem or acquisition announcement was found, so the cause is not public and failure factors are left empty. A Product Hunt page describes an AI-driven product, suggesting activity at some unknown date.
notes: The seed rests on the press release plus aggregators. Seedtable names Y Combinator as lead; CB Insights dates the round March 2022 and lists the stage as acquired with about 3.38M total raised, with no buyer or date (unverified). Riverside and Zencastr sources are dated about five months after the batch start and came from search results, not opened pages. clearmix.com did not resolve in this session (network allowlist), so the site was not checked. No total raised was stated in sources.
